title: Queen in the Corner
setup: Black's queen has eaten its way into a1, where your own pawns on a2 and b2 already fence it in.
hint: The back rank is wide open to it. Find the piece that attacks it and covers both of them.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rc1}} attacks the queen and takes b1 away. a2 is guarded by the knight on b4, b2 and c1 by the knight on d3, so every capture it has loses it. {{Qxc1}} {{Nxc1}} is the best on offer: a queen for a rook.
